input.query: WITH base AS (SELECT 'ab' p, * FROM abnormal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', * FROM normal_traces), ch AS (SELECT p, parent_span_id, sum(duration) cd FROM base GROUP BY 1,2), own AS (SELECT b.p, b.service_name svc, b.attr_span_kind k, b.duration - coalesce(ch.cd,0) own FROM base b LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.parent_span_id=b.span_id AND ch.p=b.p WHERE b.attr_span_kind='Server' ) SELECT svc, round(quantile_cont(CASE WHEN p='norm' THEN own END,0.95)/1e6,1) norm_own95, round(quantile_cont(CASE WHEN p='ab' THEN own END,0.95)/1e6,1) ab_own95, count(CASE WHEN p='norm' THEN 1 END) nn, count(CASE WHEN p='ab' THEN 1 END) na FROM own GROUP BY svc ORDER BY ab_own95 DESC
